purpose: Freeze the next three CPI and three Employment Situation release windows from official BLS schedules and compute a fail-closed activation packet before licensed shadow capture.
hypothesis: A deterministic roster can preserve official dates, handle the November daylight-saving transition, identify the single currently activatable window, and block it when credential and rights inputs are absent without counting a missed window as evidence.

decision_rule.READY_FOR_CAMPAIGN_ACTIVATION_PENDING_VE: The official six-window roster, DST conversion, activation deadlines and failure injections pass exactly as preregistered.
decision_rule.FAIL_CAMPAIGN_ROSTER: A source, date, timezone, family floor, freshness, expiry, preregistration or test gate fails.
decision_rule.CAPTURE_WINDOW: Reserved for a future live run whose credential, rights, fresh official schedule and Phase 3-5 stores all pass before release.

economic_decision: The roster authorizes no historical reconstruction, price join, model fitting or trading. Only prospectively captured and enrolled windows may advance.
out_of_scope: opening an authenticated connection without user-supplied credentials and written rights
treating the normalized roster as an empirical observation
backfilling a missed release as a live receipt
